text:
Situation: Furosemide injection remains in shortage per FDA records first posted 2020-04-07 and still current as of 2026-10-21. Hospira, Inc. (Pfizer) holds a current shortage listing for NDC 0409-6102-02. Corvale East has 8.5 days of 10 mg/mL 2 mL vials on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 28 days of the same presentation. Corvale General holds 18 days across two lots.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the furosemide injection shortage on 2020-04-07 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. An FDA inspection of Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25. A Warning Letter was issued to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25.

Our position: Internal transfer from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East is the fastest way to extend Corvale East supply while preserving adequate stock at both sites. Oral tablets and other injection lots at Corvale General remain well stocked.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 33 vials of furosemide 10 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Monitor Corvale East days of supply daily and report to P&T committee weekly — approved by pharmacy director.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., or Civica, Inc. if transfer does not sustain supply — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Transfer from Corvale General at this time; Lakeside transfer meets the need with less disruption.
